calls.description: Judge calls (an upper bound: the adaptive phase can stop early).
calls.title: Calls

input_token_count.description: ``"exact"`` when the text was counted with the judge's tokenizer, ``"approximate"`` when it was estimated from characters (the judge names no tokenizer).
input_token_count.title: Input Token Count

wall_s.description: Wall time in seconds at the judge's concurrency (approximate).
wall_s.title: Wall S

StageEstimate.description: One stage's share of a CostEstimate.
StageEstimate.title: StageEstimate

Usage.description:
Requests and tokens accumulated by a transport or a role client; merge instances with
merged_with.

One type for every role: a role client's ``usage`` property is this shape, the run manifest serialises it
per step and per run, and the transport accumulates it. Tokens and requests only -- the wire reports
nothing else (an endpoint's cached-input detail is not tracked and stays 0).

cached_input_tokens.description: The endpoint's cached-input detail, when it reports one; the shared transport's accounting does not track it and it stays 0.
cached_input_tokens.title: Cached Input Tokens

failed_requests.description: Requests the transport raised on, sent or not; a parked-out request and one the rejection rule refuses are the outage's, not a request's. A role client folds its own refusals (a reply its adapter raised on) in on top.
failed_requests.title: Failed Requests

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens summed over the requests that reported them.
input_tokens.title: Input Tokens

output_tokens.description: Completion tokens summed over the requests that reported them.
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens

requests.description: Requests sent, as the transport counts them: one logical request however many retries it took; a reply the status map returns (even one the adapter refuses) counts as one.
requests.title: Requests

Usage.title: Usage

description: What a judging command did (``judged``) or would take (``estimate``).

judgements.description: Judgements of the judged queries now in the store.
judgements.title: Judgements

stored.description: Windows of this stage in the store before the command ran.
stored.title: Stored
